reading: Both stills are a featureless grey blur, and a third at 20:51:49 UTC is the same. The lens is far out of focus, or something translucent is in front of it. The blur, about 300-550 px across in a full-resolution still, is what a lens zoomed in to about 27 mm at f/1.4 and focused near infinity would give at this distance (0.85 mm on the sensor); at 9 mm it would be about 60 px. So the zoom and focus have most likely been turned since the sharp frames of 2026-10-20.
